purpose: Logging-specific bounds recorded before correcting the reproduced oversized-record and idle-disconnect gaps; Requests and coverage criteria are unchanged
overflowPolicy: Replace an oversized record or input line with a payload-free explicit omission warning. Share immutable serialized records between history and live delivery. Disconnect lagging, excess or stalled readers explicitly. Never wait for a UI reader to consume a log.
ordering: Subscribe and snapshot under the same recording lock so replay and live delivery have one atomic boundary. Reconnect replays retained records without claiming exactly-once delivery across connections.
cleanup: Idle close, protocol error, owner shutdown and send timeout release the subscription. A disconnected browser must not leave an idle receiver alive.
scope: Local emulator logs only, not a persistent audit log. No private consumer logs enter public test fixtures. These caps supplement the unchanged Requests and coverage manifests.
